verdict.rationale: React's docs describe async components that fetch data on the server or at build time [react-docs-7], 'use client' to mark interactive client modules [react-docs-10], and streaming HTML while data loads [react-docs-6]. However, this only works through a framework that implements the architecture, such as Next.js App Router [react-docs-4, react-docs-21], not React alone. missing for 10: works without a full-stack framework, explicit docs on passing server-fetched data as props across the server/client boundary, independent or hands-on corroboration.
